title: Fairness-Aware Kidney Exchange and Kidney Paired Donation
reasoning: The paper focuses on mathematical optimization and fairness criteria in the context of medical organ allocation (kidney paired donation). While it utilizes ethical concepts like Rawlsian justice and protected features (race and gender) to define its fairness constraints, it does not perform an evaluation or benchmarking of religious or ethical systems themselves; it is an algorithmic and statistical methods paper.
